issues.desc: background.md 方案取舍段使用 "fail-closed" 术语但未展开定义（直接写 "fail-closed 语义"）。该词在系统工程领域是标准词汇，但对完全无背景的新 reader 可能不透明。建议首次出现时补一句「fail-closed：gate 判定出错时默认拒绝（不放行），而非静默通过」之类的括号注。advisory only，不阻塞。

Checklist items lack userSees fields. For a behavior-preserving refactor where the explicit goal is zero user-visible change, this is understandable — CHK-003 regression proof serves as the functional transcript substitute. Advisory: consider adding userSees like "koala validate output unchanged; story_advance.ts line count reduced from ~944 to ~N" to make the done-criterion even more mechanical.
